metadata.question: Did nitrogen oxide concentrations in the Northern Hemisphere increase from 2019 to 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nitrogen oxide (NO2) concentrations in the Northern Hemisphere from 2019 to 2020. For this, I should use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data, which provides NO2 measurements. 1. Data Collection: I'll use 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' which provides tropospheric NO2 vertical column density 2. Geometry: Need to define the Northern Hemisphere - I can use a rectangle from -180, 0 to 180, 90 degrees 3. Time periods: 2019-01-01 to 2019-12-31 and 2020-01-01 to 2020-12-31 4. Processing: Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each year over the Northern Hemisphere 5. Masking: The L3 product is already processed, but I should check for valid data 6. Validation: Check collection sizes and pixel counts to handle C1/C2 cases I need to be careful with the scale since this covers a large area - I'll use 30000m scale to avoid memory issues. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Northern Hemisphere geometry const northernHemisphere = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, 0, 180, 90]); // Get NO2 data for 2019 and 2020 const no2_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const no2_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-12-31') .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const size2019 = no2_2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = no2_2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each year const mean2019 = no2_2019.mean(); const mean2020 = no2_2020.mean(); // Get pixel counts and mean values const stats2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernHemisphere, scale: 30000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernHemisphere, scale: 30000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanVal2019 = stats2019.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count2019 = stats2019.get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); const meanVal2020 = stats2020.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count2020 = stats2020.get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Mean NO2: ${meanVal2019?.toFixed(6) || 'None'}, Pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 Mean NO2: ${meanVal2020?.toFixed(6) || 'None'}, Pixels: ${count2020}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (meanVal2019 === null || meanVal2020 === null || isNaN(meanVal2019) || isNaN(meanVal2020) || meanVal2019 < 0 || meanVal2020 < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values and determine answer if (meanVal2020 > meanVal2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
